[EN] Sorcha's Reckless Challenge
[ES] El desafío imprudente de Sorcha
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Work together to beat this challenge!
[ES] ¡Trabajen juntos para superar este desafío!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I'm just glad she's safe—this time.
[ES] Me alegro de que esté a salvo, esta vez.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ah... That was close!
[ES] Ah... ¡Estuvo cerca!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take the teleportal to the Tainted Gorge Bridge, activate the magical device, and protect Sorcha for 7 minutes.
[ES] Usa el portal hacia el puente del desfiladero corrompido, activa el dispositivo mágico y protege a Sorcha durante 7 minutos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "You're welcome."
[ES] "De nada."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You've done it! Speak with Sorcha.
[ES] ¡Lo has logrado! Habla con Sorcha.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "For the federation!"
[ES] "¡Por la federación!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the teleportal to return to the Tower Base and report to Jorhon.
[ES] Usa el portal para regresar a la base de la torre e infórmale a Jorhon.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
